Do not install, authenticate, publish or authorize spending through this choice.

Website chooser: https://kloudy.ai/api/customer/visual-chooser/start#return=ed607d469ca6f19a5396cca7a1b4b756
Open this HTTPS link if your host does not show the card. Complete account sign-in/2FA on the website before opening private project choices. Email is a lookup hint, not proof. The host controls card rendering, clickable links and browser launch. Account-bound automatic return is not established by this public template locator.

Open https://kloudy.ai/api/customer/visual-chooser/start#return=ed607d469ca6f19a5396cca7a1b4b756 in your signed-in account. Confirm the waiting IDE code 744FB0FD and the existing project. Then return the selection; receive_website_selection waits on this same MCP connection. The locator grants no account authority.
